newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades Green Mountain.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades Green Mountain.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it downgraded the ratings of Green Mountain Power Corp based on the company's increased risk of financial weakening.
It downgraded Green Mountain's mortgage bonds and secured medium-term notes to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus and unsecured medium-term notes to Triple B from Triple B Plus.
Duff & Phelps also lowered Green Mountain's preferred stock rating to Triple B from Triple B Plus.

As competition in the region intensifies and prices begin to fall and reflect market-based rates, Green Mountain's ability to obtain adequate rate relief to offset increased purchased power obligations is likely to be limited, Duff & Phelps said.
